answer: Failure mode: one operator answers for a hundred accounts. Random re-execution closes it. A peer drawn at random reruns the work, and funds release only after three confirmations from unrelated subnetworks. A cloned sparrow cannot be its own witness, so the farm waits on strangers who owe it nothing. On a rising tide of duplicates the queue stalls and the payout never lands, and the river of new accounts cannot unblock it. Three strangers per payment is the honest cost of each fake account.
